summary: Optimum Communications filed an 8-K to disclose entry into a Second Amended and Restated Credit Agreement for an incremental $250M term loan at 9.000% fixed rate, maturing November 25, 2028, with proceeds for general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt refinancing, not a special situation. No acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, tender offer, strategic review, or other special-situations event is present.
